_about: What 'python tune.py' tries. Each variant changes ONE setting from settings.json. 'videos' empty means every video in test_videos/. 'vibes' can give a video a music feeling, e.g. {"my_video": "suspenseful"}.

variants.label: Music further back
variants.why: Music 4 dB quieter again, so the effects carry the scene.

variants.label: Music allowed to build
variants.why: Stops flattening the music's swells, so suspense can start quiet and grow.

variants.label: Sparser music
variants.value: {genre}, {mood}, sparse minimal underscore, {instruments}, slow build, lots of space, no vocals
variants.why: Asks the music model for a thin underscore instead of a full background track.

variants.label: One clear effect per shot
variants.why: Tells the effects model only the most important sound in each shot, not the whole list.

variants.label: Effects follow the description harder
variants.why: Pushes the effects model to stick closer to the planned sounds (4.5 to 6.5).

variants.label: Effects made over longer stretches
variants.why: Joins quick shots into clips of up to 8 seconds, so effects flow across cuts instead of restarting.
